+def _get_locale_pak_path(locales_dir: pathlib.Path, locale_name: str) -> pathlib.Path:
+    """Get the QtWebEngine resource file for a locale."""
+    return locales_dir / (locale_name.replace('_', '-') + '.pak')
+
+
+def _get_lang_override(
+        versions: version.WebEngineVersions, locale_name: str,
+) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Return a Chromium locale to use when QtWebEngine lacks the system locale."""
+    if (not config.val.qt.workarounds.locale or not utils.is_linux or
+            versions.webengine != utils.VersionNumber(5, 15, 3)):
+        return None
+
+    locales_dir = (pathlib.Path(QLibraryInfo.location(QLibraryInfo.TranslationsPath)) /
+                   'qtwebengine_locales')
+    locale_name = locale_name.replace('_', '-')
+    if _get_locale_pak_path(locales_dir, locale_name).is_file():
+        return None
+
+    language = locale_name.split('-', maxsplit=1)[0]
+    if language == 'en':
+        us_english = {'en', 'en-US', 'en-LR', 'en-PH'}
+        mapped_locale = 'en-US' if locale_name in us_english else 'en-GB'
+    elif language == 'es':
+        mapped_locale = 'es' if locale_name in {'es', 'es-ES'} else 'es-419'
+    elif language == 'pt':
+        mapped_locale = ('pt-BR' if locale_name in {'pt', 'pt-BR'}
+                         else 'pt-PT')
+    elif language == 'zh':
+        mapped_locale = ('zh-TW' if locale_name in {'zh-TW', 'zh-HK', 'zh-MO'}
+                         else 'zh-CN')
+    else:
+        mapped_locale = language
+
+    for candidate in (mapped_locale, language):
+        if _get_locale_pak_path(locales_dir, candidate).is_file():
+            return candidate
+
+    return 'en-US'
+
